headline: Zoning applications for 50R Maplewood Avenue and seven other addresses, including 55 Holly Street and 81 Western Avenue.
summary: The agenda lists one continued review request for 50R Maplewood Avenue. It also lists seven new applications for special permits and/or variances at properties on several streets.
items: Approve the Chair signing decisions for 103 Essex Ave., 18 Rogers St., 14R Becker Cir., 21 Walnut St., and 8 Angle St.
50R Maplewood Avenue, Map 24, Lot 3, Bigelow Real Estate, LLC: review request for substantial change to modify comprehensive permit conditions and project plans (760 CMR 56.05(11)(c)).
55 Holly St., Map 123, Lot 35, Brian and Kelsey D'Angelo: special permit and/or variance to construct a second story addition in the R-80 zoning district.
125 Eastern Point Blvd., Map 137, Lots 6 & 7, Eastern Point Yacht Club C/O Peter Strong: special permit and/or variance for an accessory use in the RC-40 zoning district.
12 Smith St., Map 26, Lot 82, 12 Smith Street LLC: special permit and/or variance to construct a dormer in the R-5 zoning district.
74 Hesperus Ave., Map 191, Lot 12, Hammond Museum Inc.: appeal of the Building Commissioner's determination requiring a special permit for an accessory use in the R-40 zoning district.
2 High Rock Ter., Map 180, Lot 43, Peter J. Carbone: special permit and/or variance to demolish and rebuild a non-conforming structure in the R-10 zoning district.
27 Addison St., Map 25, Lot 52, Lauri Francis: special permit and/or variance to convert a two family to a three family with relief of lesser number of parking in the R-5 zoning district.

81 Western Ave., Map 3, Lot 34, 81 Western Ave. Realty Trust: special permit and/or variance to demolish and rebuild a non-conforming structure and increase coverage in an AE zone in the R-5 zoning district.

# NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

**CITY OF GLOUCESTER**
**ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS**
**October 29, 2026 Meeting, 7 PM**

Kyrouz Auditorium,
City Hall, 2ND Floor
9 Dale Avenue
Gloucester, MA 01930

Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available:

**ZBA Meeting: October 29, 2026**
**Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/88339781243**
**Join via Phone: +1 (312) 626-6799, Alternate: +1 (929) 205-6099**

### Approval of Minutes:

10/8/2026

### Consent Agenda:

1. Approval of the Chair to sign the following decisions.
   a. 103 Essex Ave.
   b. 18 Rogers St.
   c. 14R Becker Cir.
   d. 21 Walnut St.
   e. 8 Angle St.

### Continued Applications:

**50R Maplewood Avenue, Map 24, Lot 3** Bigelow Real Estate, LLC, Review request for substantial change to modify comprehensive permit conditions and project plans. 760 CMR 56.05(11)(c)

### New Applications:

Application of Brian and Kelsey D'Angelo seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct a second story addition at **55 Holly St., Map 123, Lot 35** in the R-80 zoning district.

Application of Eastern Point Yacht Club C/O Peter Strong seeking a special permit and/ or variance for an accessory use at **125 Eastern Point Blvd., Map 137, Lots 6 & 7** in the RC-40 zoning district.

Application of 12 Smith Street LLC seeking a special permit and/or variance to construct a dormer at **12 Smith St., Map 26, Lot 82** in the R-5 zoning district.

Application of Hammond Museum Inc. appealing the determination of the Building Commissioner requiring a special permit for an accessory use at **74 Hesperus Ave., Map 191, Lot 12** in the R-40 zoning district.

Application of Peter J. Carbone seeking a special permit and/ or variance to demolish and rebuild a non-conforming structure at **2 High Rock Ter., Map 180, Lot 43** in the R-10 zoning district.

Application of Lauri Francis seeking a special permit and/ or variance to convert from a two family to a three family with relief of lesser number of parking at **27 Addison St., Map 25, Lot 52** in the R-5 zoning district.

Application of 81 Western Ave. Realty Trust seeking a special permit and/ or variance to demolish and rebuild a non-conforming structure and to increase coverage in an AE zone at **81 Western Ave., Map 3, Lot 34** in the R-5 zoning district.

### Discussion by Board:

Approving the 2027 ZBA Meeting Calendar

### Adjournment:

Joseph Parisi, III, Chairman

The above agenda items are those reasonably anticipated by the Chair to be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed, items not listed may also be brought up for discussion, to the extent permitted by law.

Please visit the Zoning Board of Appeals page on the City's website to view the above applications and petitions and direct all questions regarding these applications to the office of the Building Inspector during normal business hours at 978-325-5210.

All documents intended to be considered by the Board must be submitted 72 hours prior to the meetings.
